The most common win left on "Billion" is $100. The second biggest prize left is $1 million, and 41 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If you play "Billion" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
762.headline: Prize table details

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has had no $15 million top prize claimed for three weeks. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

The second-biggest prize left on "50th Anniversary" is $1 million, with three of them remaining.

The numbers for "50th Anniversary" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
827.headline: Tickets sell, top prizes remain

847.body:
All the top prizes on "Bingo 50X" have been claimed. That lowers the biggest prize from $500,000 to $100,000. That level still has two unclaimed. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

The numbers for "Bingo 50X" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
847.headline: Big prize shown, none left

891.body:
The most common win left on "Cash Explosion 25X" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and one of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If "Cash Explosion 25X" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
